**v1.11.1: the battle simulator boosts with no hit in hand, and past "Boosts before each hit" while no hit can be paid for - as the bot does.**
- **What was wrong.** With no hit in hand, the simulator (the boss deck pick, the planner, the zone deck) cast no blade, trap or aura: it passed, or cast Tower Shield, an absorb that costs no pips or a Reshuffle. The bot boosts for your school's hit then - your school's trap and blade, the Elemental / Spirit one of your school, Feint, Hex, Balanceblade, Bladestorm and your school's aura, in its usual order. With "Boosts before each hit" (`boostmax`) set, the simulator stopped boosting once that many boosts had gone since the last hit, even with no hit in hand it could pay for - it passed while a Storm Lord waited for its 7 pips. The bot holds its boosts back only while a hit can go, so it boosts on while it waits: there's nothing else to do. And the simulator counted only the boosts that landed, where the bot counts each one that went out (it can't see a fizzle) and starts the count again at any hit that went out, a fizzled one too.
- **What changes.** The simulator now plays all three as the bot does: with no hit in hand it casts the boosts for your school's hit (none with your school not known, as before); with `boostmax` set it boosts on past it while no hit in hand can be paid for; and it counts the boosts at the click, as the bot counts them. A party's Blader or Healer plays as before: it always boosted for the hitter's school, with no limit. Nothing changes in the game: the bot plays its cards as it always has, there is no new setting, and the AutoFarmer sends the helper nothing new.
- **Measured on the same dice** (2000 battles a cell, each battle on the same seed in v1.11.0 and v1.11.1): v1.11.0's wizard and enemies - a Storm wizard (a Balance one for the Hydra decks) with 3000 health and 60% damage against a 6000-health boss or 3 mobs of 1500 health (2-pip hits of 150-200 and 100-150 that always land), "Boost first, then hit". % won v1.11.0 -> v1.11.1 with `discardspent` on (this AutoFarmer's default), then with `reboost` on; in brackets, the battles only v1.11.1 won / only v1.11.0 won. First with `boostmax` 0 (the default), where only the boosts with no hit in hand play a part:
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 97.0% -> 97.6% (+12 / -1); 96.8% -> 99.8% (+59 / -0); with `discardspent` off 89.1% -> 93.7% (+91 / -0). 3 mobs: 44.1% -> 44.5% (+15 / -7); 75.3% -> 77.7% (+47 / -0).
  - 6 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 3 Storm Aura: the boss 82.0% -> 81.5% (+10 / -20); 85.5% -> 95.3% (+198 / -0). 3 mobs: 60.2% -> 60.2% (+21 / -20); 71.3% -> 78.8% (+149 / -0). With `reboost` on, each hit lets the boosts it fits go again, so a hand with no hit has more to cast.
  - Decks heavy in boosts, with few hits, where a hand with no hit comes up often. 3 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 3 Storm Aura + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap (a boost cast with no hit in hand in 40% of the battles against the boss): the boss 48.6% -> 61.1% (+279 / -30); 50.5% -> 81.6% (+622 / -0); with "Hit first (fast)" 32.8% -> 42.4% (+221 / -29). 3 mobs: 11.6% -> 13.3% (+58 / -24); 19.2% -> 32.1% (+257 / -0). 4 Storm Lord + 2 Feint + 4 Stormblade + 4 Elemental Blade + 4 Storm Trap + 2 Bladestorm: the boss 82.8% -> 82.5% (+36 / -42); 75.7% -> 94.0% (+366 / -0). 3 mobs: 10.1% -> 10.2% (+26 / -22); 46.0% -> 57.0% (+218 / -0). Balance: 4 Hydra + 4 Elemental Blade + 4 Balanceblade + 4 Bladestorm + 3 Sharpened Blade (with no hit in hand, the boosts for a Balance hit: Balanceblade and Bladestorm, not Elemental Blade): the boss 32.3% -> 36.0% (+87 / -13); 63.1% -> 72.4% (+186 / -0). 3 mobs: 3.1% -> 3.1% (+4 / -3); 45.0% -> 51.1% (+123 / -0).
  - 4 Storm Lord + 4 Tempest + 3 Stormblade + 3 Storm Trap + 2 Feint + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 96.7% -> 97.5% (+17 / -0); 97.2% -> 98.3% (+24 / -0). 3 mobs: 91.0% -> 91.9% (+18 / -1); 90.7% -> 91.9% (+24 / -0).
  - Balance: 8 Hydra + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 2 Balanceblade + 3 Sharpened Blade: the boss 88.7% -> 89.2% (+9 / -0); 95.0% -> 95.4% (+8 / -0). 3 mobs: 40.2% -> 40.4% (+3 / -0); 50.0% -> 50.1% (+3 / -0).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 4 Stormblade + 4 Storm Trap at 40% (or 4 Elemental Trap) + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap: the boss 96.5% -> 97.2% (+14 / -0) (97.2% -> 98.0%, +14 / -0); 98.1% -> 99.3% (+25 / -0) (98.5% -> 99.7%, +25 / -0). 3 mobs: 45.9% -> 46.5% (+12 / -0) (47.7% -> 48.3%, +12 / -0); 75.0% -> 76.2% (+22 / -0) (77.2% -> 78.3%, +23 / -0).
  - The same battles, battle for battle, with `discardspent` on, with `reboost` on, with "Hit first (fast)" and with `discardspent` off: 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade (the boss 92.2%, 3 mobs 34.2% with `discardspent` on); 8 Storm Lord + 1 Stormblade + 1 Sharpened Blade; 10 Thunder Snake + 6 Storm Lord + 4 Sharpened Blade (no blade); 8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade. With these a hand with no hit and a boost to cast hardly ever comes up. 8 Storm Lord + 3 Bladestorm + 3 Storm Aura + 3 Stormblade: the same battles with `discardspent` on and with `reboost` on, the same number won with the other two (1991 to 1997 of 2000 battles the same).
- **With `boostmax` set the numbers move a lot**, mostly towards `boostmax` 0's (`discardspent` on, all three changes): the bot, and now the simulator, boosts on while the hit in hand waits for its pips, where v1.11.0 passed. So `boostmax` 1 no longer spreads the blades over hits while a hit waits for pips - the bot doesn't spread them either. If you set `boostmax`, the boss deck pick and the zone deck may come out differently.
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against 3 mobs, `boostmax` 1: 58.5% -> 34.5% (+77 / -556); `boostmax` 0 wins 34.2%. v1.11.0 put the plain and the sharpened Stormblade on two Storm Lords, one each; now both go on the Storm Lord that waits for its 7 pips. Against the boss 92.2% -> 92.2% (+57 / -56). `boostmax` 2: the same battles (one blade slot: never more than two boosts a hit).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap + 2 Sharpened Blade + 2 Potent Trap, `boostmax` 1: the boss 94.8% -> 97.8% (+94 / -36), 3 mobs 88.6% -> 48.7% (+57 / -855); `boostmax` 2: the boss 96.8% -> 97.7% (+36 / -18), 3 mobs 71.8% -> 48.5% (+98 / -566). With `reboost` on too, `boostmax` 1: the boss 68.2% -> 99.9% (+635 / -0), 3 mobs 70.8% -> 89.5% (+487 / -114).
  - 8 Storm Lord + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 3 Sharpened Blade, `boostmax` 1: the boss 96.4% -> 98.1% (+62 / -28), 3 mobs 93.5% -> 52.0% (+23 / -852).
  - The Tempest + Feint deck above, `boostmax` 1: the boss 83.0% -> 96.2% (+318 / -54), 3 mobs 77.5% -> 92.8% (+391 / -86).
  - Balance: 8 Hydra + 3 Elemental Blade + 3 Stormblade + 2 Balanceblade + 3 Sharpened Blade against 3 mobs, `boostmax` 1: 0.0% -> 45.4% (+907 / -0) - v1.11.0 passed while each Hydra waited for its 6 pips with one blade on it, and lost every battle; `boostmax` 2: 38.5% -> 44.6% (+343 / -221). Against the boss, `boostmax` 1: 82.0% -> 87.8% (+276 / -159).
  - The boost-heavy decks above, `boostmax` 1: the 3 Storm Lord deck, the boss 5.8% -> 47.0% (+892 / -69), 3 mobs 15.4% -> 13.4% (+212 / -251); the Feint + Bladestorm deck, the boss 58.8% -> 80.7% (+618 / -181), 3 mobs 62.5% -> 22.0% (+154 / -965); the 4 Hydra deck, the boss 0.0% -> 3.2% (+64 / -0), 3 mobs 0.0% -> 17.1% (+342 / -0).
  - With "Hit first (fast)" and `boostmax` 1 it's much the same: the 8 Storm Lord + 6 Stormblade + 6 Storm Trap deck against 3 mobs 88.0% -> 51.6% (+62 / -789), the Tempest + Feint deck against the boss 82.2% -> 92.8% (+315 / -101).
- **The simulator plays everything else exactly as before**, against v1.11.0: on 270 random decks (9990 comparisons: 8100 simulate, 1350 planner as Hitter, Blader and Healer, 270 team plan and 270 deck pick), every comparison in which the simulator never cast a boost with no hit in hand, never boosted past `boostmax` with no hit to pay for and never had a card fizzle with `boostmax` set came out the same: 6317 of them, 0 differing. With `boostmax` 0 (6906 comparisons): the 4204 in which no hand without a hit came up, and the 1096 in which one came up with no boost for your school in it, are all the same; 1519 of the 1606 in which a boost went with no hit in hand differ. The 25 decks with no blade, trap or aura play the same everywhere (750 simulate, 125 planner, 25 team plan comparisons). With `boostmax` set, a hand that always holds a hit isn't enough: 375 of 1995 such comparisons differ - a hit in hand not paid for yet (the boosts now go on) or a fizzle (now counted). 2504 of the 9990 differ in all, as they should.
- **Mixed versions are fine.** An older AutoFarmer with this helper: its simulator boosts this way too - every v1.x AutoFarmer boosts with no hit in hand and past `boostmax` while no hit can go. This AutoFarmer with an older helper: that helper's way, as before. The zone deck is worked out once more after updating.
- **Nothing to try in the game.** The bot plays as before, so there is no LIVE_CHECKS step. To compare with the bot, with the game's hand read: debug.log's "plan: no hit: ..." line ends "this round: ..." with the blades and traps the bot can put up with no hit in hand, and "N boosts since the last hit (boostmax M): hitting now" is written only while a hit can go.
- **Still not in it:** saving pips for a finishing hit (`pipsave` - the bot casts no other hit while it waits and boosts past `boostmax` meanwhile; the simulator counts any hit it can pay for as one that can go); with every hit switched off (`usehit1` to `usehit4` 0) and the game's hand read, the bot's boosts for the strongest hit in that hand (the simulator boosts for your school's); the prism, Attenuate and your school's bubble in the bot's boost chain (the simulator plays none of them); your own PlayerStats.txt %s for Balanceblade, Bladestorm, Hex and Feint (`blade3`, `blade4`, `trap3`, `feint`: the simulator tells those cards apart by the nearest of the defaults, 25, 20, 30 and 70); the enemies' cheats.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install, including ones set up from the v0.7.0 or v0.7.1 zips. Your settings, learned cards and routes are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
